topic: Tracking 80 residency visa expiry dates across 25 companies — what system are you actually using right now?
format: Open with a specific Sanad or PRO failure moment — a visa that expired, a client who found out at the airport, a missed MOL filing — make it so specific the reader stops scrolling
post:
A client called me at 7 AM from Muscat Airport.

His employee's residency visa had expired three days earlier. No one caught it. The file was buried in row 94 of a shared Excel sheet that four people had edit access to — and nobody owned.

That call cost the client a deportation fine, a flight rebooking, and two weeks of replacement paperwork.

It cost the Sanad office something harder to recover: the client's trust.

If you're managing work permit tracking in Oman across 20+ companies, you already know this risk. Not hypothetically. You've felt it.

The Excel has no alerts. WhatsApp has no audit trail. And when a visa slips — everyone remembers who was supposed to catch it.

80 expiry dates across 25 companies is not a memory problem. It's a systems problem.

SmartPRO Hub was built for exactly this: automatic expiry alerts per worker, per company, per service type — before the deadline, not after the airport call.
